```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r load}
library(jaxExperiment)
```

## Initialize experiment

```{r init}
dataset_name = "JAX_RNAseq13"
release_label = "December 2025 release"
output_prefix = "2025_12_JAX_RNAseq13"

release_dir = "/fh/fast/sun_w/MorPhiC/data/MorPhiC_internal_releases/MorPhiC_Release_December_2025/JAX_RNAseq13"
metadata_file = file.path(release_dir, "metadata", "JAX_RNAseq13_metadata_CORRECTED_FinalVersion.xlsx")
counts_file = file.path(release_dir, "processed/Tables", "genesCounts.csv")
gene_annotation_file = "../../data/gencode_v44_primary_assembly_info.tsv"

outputs_dir = "outputs"
unified_meta_file = file.path(outputs_dir, paste0(dataset_name, "_meta_data.tsv"))

spec = stage1_spec_default()

expt = experiment(
  dataset_name = dataset_name,
  release_label = release_label,
  metadata_file = metadata_file,
  counts_file = counts_file,
  gene_annotation_file = gene_annotation_file,
  outputs_dir = outputs_dir,
  unified_meta_file = unified_meta_file,
  config = list(output_prefix = output_prefix, release_dir = release_dir)
)
```

## Validate inputs

```{r}
expt = stage1_validate(expt, spec = spec)
```

## Read + QC metadata workbook

```{r}
expt = stage1_read(expt, spec = spec)
expt = stage1_check(expt, spec = spec)

rep = stage1_report(expt)
knitr::kable(rep$qc_table_summary, caption = "Stage 1 QC sheet summary", row.names = FALSE)
knitr::kable(rep$relations_summary, caption = "Stage 1 cross-sheet check summary", row.names = FALSE)
```

## Build unified metadata + write outputs

```{r}
expt = stage1_unify(expt, spec = spec)
expt = stage1_write_meta(expt)
```

## Check alignment to count matrix

```{r}
expt = stage1_read_counts(expt)
expt = stage1_check_alignment(expt)
```

## Save experiment object (for later stages)

```{r}
save_experiment(expt, file.path(outputs_dir, "experiment.rds"))
```

```{r}
gc()
sessionInfo()
```
